title: Relationship (Human)
description: A meaningful relationship — the human experience of connection, not just the legal or operational link. Captures quality, history, and what the relationship means to a person. Complements the operational Relationship schema in people/.

person_id.description: The person for whom this relationship is described

other_name.description: Used when the other person is not an OLP record

description.description: What this relationship means to the person — in their own words

needs_served.description: Need slugs this relationship serves, e.g. belonging, love, trust

values_expressed.description: Value slugs expressed through this relationship

quality.description: Current relationship quality from this person's perspective

is_priority.description: Is this a priority relationship the person wants to nurture?

linked_relationship_id.description: Optional link to operational people/relationship.schema.json record
